---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the use case for this feature.

**Example scenario:**
> As a user, I want to [do something] so that [benefit/reason].

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

### YAML Syntax (if applicable)

```yaml
# Example of how you'd expect to use this feature
suite_name: "Feature Example"

steps:
  - name: "New feature usage"
    # Your proposed syntax here
```

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Notes (optional)

If you have technical insights on how this could be implemented:

- Files that might need changes
- Potential impacts on existing functionality
- Suggested approach

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can help with documentation
